description:
Episode 40 of a daily journey through the universe. 👽
We search for alien life: icy moons with hidden oceans, Enceladus spraying water into space, phosphorus found in its ocean in 2023, Europa Clipper arriving in 2030, and the hunt in other planets' air.

➡️ Tomorrow, Episode 41: Next stop, the Wow! signal. A message from space never explained.

segments.text: Episode forty. Next stop... where we might find alien life.
If life exists beyond Earth, our best bets may be icy moons with oceans hidden under their shells.
segments.headline: Oceans under the ice

segments.text: Saturn's moon Enceladus sprays water into space from cracks near its south pole. The Cassini spacecraft flew right through the spray.
segments.headline: A moon that sprays water

segments.text: Its ocean holds many of the ingredients life needs. In twenty twenty-three, scientists even found phosphorus.
NASA's Europa Clipper is on its way to Jupiter's moon Europa, to find out if its ocean could support life.
segments.headline: Europa Clipper is on the way

segments.text: And beyond our solar system, telescopes are studying the air of distant planets, looking for signs of life.
segments.headline: Searching other planets' air

segments.text: Tomorrow, a mysterious signal from space that has never been explained. Next stop: the Wow signal. Follow, so you don't miss episode forty-one.
